requirement.normalizedRequirement: Set the vertical extent of framing ice strengthening from Table 4-6. IF upper_bow_ice_belt_required = true, THEN framing_ice_strengthening_upper_extent >= upper_bow_ice_belt_top. IF extension_beyond_adjacent_deck_or_tank_boundary_mm <= 250, THEN termination_at_that_boundary is permitted. Table 4-6 values: IA Super framing above UIWL 1.2 m; below LIWL bow down to tank top or below top of floors, midbody 2.0 m, stern 1.6 m. IA, IB and IC framing above UIWL 1.0 m; below LIWL bow 1.6 m, midbody 1.3 m, stern 1.0 m.
requirement.section: Vertical extension of ice strengthening for framing
requirement.source: Ice Class Regulations and the Application Thereof
requirement.sourceText: The vertical extension of the ice strengthening of framing shall be at least as given in Table 4- 6. Where an upper bow ice belt is required (see 4.3.1), the ice-strengthened part of the framing shall be extended to at least the top of this ice belt. Where the ice-strengthening would go beyond a deck, the top or bottom plating of a tank or tank top by no more than 250 mm, it can be terminated at that deck, top or bottom plating of the tank or tank top. Table 4-6 values: IA Super framing above UIWL 1.2 m; below LIWL bow down to tank top or below top of floors, midbody 2.0 m, stern 1.6 m. IA, IB and IC framing above UIWL 1.0 m; below LIWL bow 1.6 m, midbody 1.3 m, stern 1.0 m.
